Marta R.: Quick Q — need a who-did-what export for a compliance review. Timeframe: 2025-02-01..2025-02-28. Need actions: model-deploy, policy-change. What's the supported export format and do we redact emails/PII by default?
Devin (infra): We expose audit exports via redwoodctl and the Console. Supported formats: jsonl, parquet, csv. By default actor email is redacted for hosted customers unless you request unredacted output or have L2 access. What's your exact timeframe and filters?
Marta R.: The timeframe above. Also need actor identity for the auditors — is there an approved path to get unredacted emails for compliance? If redaction is default, what field names will auditors see?
Alex - Security: For unredacted exports you must open an access request (internal link) and get Security + Legal sign-off. We only hand unredacted data through the approved process and will log the disclosure. See https://redwood.internal/privacy/requests
Sam (sre): Note retention constraints — hosted data default retention is 90 days; if the events are older they won't be in the export. Dedicated/private customers can have custom retention. You can query retention with: `redwoodctl audit retention check --org my-org`
Marta R.: Got it. Can you paste the exact redwoodctl command and the schema (column names) auditors expect?
Devin (infra): Sure — example:
```
redwoodctl audit export \
  --from 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z \
  --to   2025-02-28T23:59:59Z \
  --filters "action:model-deploy,policy-change" \
  --format jsonl \
  --output /tmp/exp_20250228.jsonl \
  --redact default
```
Fields included (json keys): `timestamp`, `event_id`, `actor_id`, `actor_email` (may be `REDACTED`), `action`, `target`, `ip`, `user_agent`, `metadata`.
If you need unredacted `actor_email` pass `--redact none` but that requires an approved access request in the console and an `--approval-token` if run by CLI.

Alex - Security: @Marta R. please file the access request (privacy ticket) and cc me. If it's time-sensitive we can expedite after review. Reminder: provide business justification and auditors' identities.
Sam (sre): If you want I can run the export with my admin creds once the request is approved — or you can run `redwoodctl` with `--as-user` if you have `audit:export` permission.
